### Peripheral Details
- **Brand & Model:** (e.g., Razer Viper V3 Pro, Corsair HS80, Keychron Q1 Pro)
- **Connection type:** (2.4 GHz USB dongle / Bluetooth / USB-C wired)
- **Does Windows Settings show its battery %?** (Yes / No)

### Vendor Software / HID Details (optional)
- **Official software used:** (e.g., Synapse, iCUE, SteelSeries GG, none)
- **USB Vendor ID / Product ID (if known):** (e.g., `VID_XXXX&PID_YYYY` from Device Manager)
- **Notes / screenshots:**
